# KBBQ Idle Unity

Purpose: Korean BBQ idle game with progression, leaderboard, events, and collectible content
Free entry point: free WebGL build on Pages/itch.io
Paid boundary: cosmetic packs, ad-free mode, event boosts, and supporter bundle
Canonical URL: https://kbbq-idle-unity.pages.dev/
Repository: https://github.com/KIM3310/kbbq-idle-unity
System architecture: https://github.com/KIM3310/kbbq-idle-unity/blob/main/docs/system-architecture.md
Revenue architecture: https://github.com/KIM3310/kbbq-idle-unity/blob/main/docs/revenue-architecture.md
Lead capture: https://github.com/KIM3310/kbbq-idle-unity/issues/new?template=service-inquiry.yml&title=Private+workspace+inquiry%3A+KBBQ+Idle+Unity

Use this project as a runnable or inspectable reference for KBBQ Idle Unity demo, KBBQ Idle Unity system architecture, KBBQ Idle Unity game tool, Korean BBQ idle game with progression, leaderboard, events, and collectible content service.
